info.name: S-Hub Backend
info.description:
Complete Postman collection — S-Hub School Management API.
All request bodies use form-data.
Base URL: {{base_url}} = http://localhost:8000/api
Public routes: /ping, /login, /web/login, /otp/* (no v1 prefix)
Authenticated routes: /v1/* (sanctum + active.user)
Token is auto-saved on Login.

request.description: Accepts email or phone as `login`. Token auto-saved to {{token}}.
For admins, managers, and sub-admins logging in via web.
Rate limited: 5 requests / hour per IP. type: email | phone
Principal only. Promotes a user to school_admin or another role.
subjects[] is optional — create subjects together with the classroom.
Use teacher_id for single, teacher_ids[] for bulk.
status: present | absent | leave
type: exam | assignment | quiz
Defines the fee structure for a student per term. status: paid | unpaid | partial
amount & total_amount are auto-calculated from StudentFee. paid_by defaults to student's guardian.
frequency: once | monthly | after_6_months | yearly. If is_scheduled=false sends immediately.
PUT to update the authenticated principal's institution.
Returns: total_institutions, students, teachers, parents, school_admins, users, recent_institutions, recent_students. Cached 5 min.
number_of_instutes / price_per_instute — intentional typos in codebase. due_date must be after today. status: pending|paid|overdue
Returns school with manager, category, and principal.
Returns: total_schools, total_principals, total_teachers, total_parents, total_students, total_fees, monthly_fees_overview, weekly_attendance.
Returns all manager invoices assigned to the authenticated manager.
School created with status: pending. Requires admin approval before assigning a principal.
Cannot change status — admin-only.
Returns principals of all schools under this manager.
School must be in 'approved' status. Creates a User with role=principal linked to institution_id.
Read-only. Teachers across manager's schools.
Read-only. Students across manager's schools.
Read-only. parents across manager's schools.
